QA Automation Portfolio - Live Reports

Live test reports generated by CI on every push to main. Source: github.com/Gikza/qa-automation-portfolio.

  • Playwright report

    End-to-end, API, accessibility, and visual regression tests, cross-browser (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit).

  • JMeter performance reports

    Smoke, load, stress, spike, and CRUD-workflow dashboards against the JSONPlaceholder API.

  • Postman/Newman report

    API tests covering JSON schema validation, response-time assertions, and a chained CRUD workflow.

Deployed automatically via GitHub Actions.
